name: Divine Stella
source:
MBTI: INFP

"I-I'm so sorry, my family's never given me permission to have one... E-Especially since I'm merely a vessel for Her Holiness... O-Our Goddess..."

The meek spirit medium who seems to only now be developing a sense of identity. Not even having a name to begin with, Stella tries to stay away from attention and shyly take everyone's word at surface value. Appearing to come from a world very foreign to anyone else, Stella claims she has no clue why they might've found themselves in this situation. Now trying to understand herself, Stella can only try her best to help the group.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
